swap_has_deadline.meaning: the submitted Router swap carries a user-specified deadline/expiration

can_remain_pending.meaning: the transaction can stay pending in the mempool past its intended window

block_timestamp.meaning: timestamp of the block that includes the swap transaction

deadline.meaning: user-specified deadline/expiration timestamp for the swap

swap_executed.meaning: the pending Router swap transaction settles on-chain

user_loss.meaning: the user incurs unexpected loss on the settled swap

preconditions.text: A user submits a Router swap with no deadline parameter; the transaction can remain pending in the mempool indefinitely.
preconditions.derivation: Conjunction of the no-deadline submission state and the possible indefinite pending state.

safety.text: Once the user-specified deadline has passed, the Router swap must not settle.
safety.derivation: Execution timestamp strictly past the deadline implies non-execution (rejection).

effects.text: The user incurs unexpected loss on the settled swap.
effects.derivation: Direct impact predicate as asserted by the impact source.

effect_coverage.reason: loss formalized as boolean user_loss; magnitude of price move and loss not quantified

assumptions: Transaction expiration is a standard security practice in AMMs such as Uniswap.
The swap can remain pending due to a gas spike or a validator withholding the transaction.
Any user-specified deadline shares the seconds unit of block timestamps.
The inclusion block timestamp is observable at execution.
unresolved: Report does not state whether any Router function variant accepts a deadline parameter.
No magnitude of price movement or quantified user loss is provided.
No specific deployed Router contract or code version is identified.
V does not assert that the swap executed after the deadline, so it does not formally witness NOT I.

limitations: Root-cause statement no_deadline_check and action late_execution are excluded from P/I/V source roles.
Impact is phrased as a possible downstream consequence, not a confirmed incident.
No aggregate or population-wide economic loss is formalized.
P states the swap carries no deadline, so the deadline symbol binds only to the intent source, not to P; this mismatch is unresolved.
V (user_loss) is a partial witness of NOT I; the settlement and timestamp-comparison conjuncts are unstated.
No multiplication, division, temporal or bitwise claims are made.
